purpose: Screen whether a predictive cross-op overlap implementation that only hides page/source stalls, without changing arithmetic or reducing hot CPU compute, can reach the 10 tok/s target.

scenarios.name: perfect_source_overlap_using_serial_touch_residual
scenarios.assumption: All page/source stall removed or hidden; hot residual CPU fallback from the serial touch diagnostic remains.

scenarios.name: perfect_source_overlap_using_parallel_touch_residual
scenarios.assumption: All page/source stall removed or hidden using the parallel-touch residual as the hot fallback estimate.

scenarios.name: source_overlap_plus_full_closed_scheduler_gap_ideal
scenarios.assumption: Source/page stall and the entire previously closed scheduling/tail gap are both removed with zero overhead.
scenarios.reason: This overcounts a scheduler/tail gap already closed as nonactionable and leaves only about 142 ms total slack before any implementation overhead, cgroup refault pressure, thread contention, or TTFT impact.

constraints_analysis.correctness: Pure source/page overlap should not change logits if it only changes fault timing, but it still must pass output correctness because page-cache pressure can alter scheduling and rejected probes must not be promoted.
constraints_analysis.ram: Any page-source preparation occurs inside the 16GB cgroup file cache. Earlier same-op touch kept memory_peak at 16GB but regressed throughput, showing page-cache pressure and touch work are real costs.
constraints_analysis.ttft: Predictive source preparation must not push accepted TTFT above 33617.688744 ms. Source-only overlap has no slack for TTFT overhead if it cannot reach 10 tok/s even with zero overhead.
constraints_analysis.dependencies: Down experts are known only after the current layer gate/up path; next-layer routes are not known until current layer output is produced, limiting safe lookahead without changing computation.

decision.reason: Even perfect source/page overlap leaves about 3173 ms hot CPU fallback and reaches only about 8.99 tok/s with zero overhead, below the 10 tok/s target. Adding the closed scheduler gap barely crosses 10 in a zero-overhead ideal with only 142 ms slack, so it is not a credible implementation target.

remaining_open_candidates: combined source overlap plus exact compute/offload that removes at least an additional 1530.405 ms after all overhead
exact compact resident representation with enough coverage to remove near-full decode up/down fallback
verified exact/token-stable GPU MXFP4 x Q8_0 path paired with a source/cache solution

next_required_work.before_runtime_code: Select one combined compute+source candidate and write a hard-bound showing more than 17386.570 ms decode saving with less than 1642.887 ms overhead, then define the top1/correctness gate.
